content.short: Pike Finance is a native cross-chain lending market that enables borrowing without the need for manual bridging.
content.description: Pike Finance is a pioneering decentralized liquidity protocol designed to solve the problem of fragmented liquidity across blockchain networks. Built on top of Wormhole and Circle CCTP, the platform allows users to supply and borrow assets natively on their original chains—such as Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum—without the security risks and friction of manual bridging or wrapped tokens. The protocol utilizes a modular architecture featuring Local Markets and Universal Vaults to ensure professional-grade risk management and deep liquidity for all decentralized asset managers.
content.meta: Pike Finance provides native cross-chain lending and borrowing services. Discover Pike Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
